chapter: Forming the band in New York
title: First professional job at Jones Beach
summary: The band's first professional engagement was a week at a Jones Beach restaurant in about 1932.

story.theme_name: First paying gigs: getting started as a young professional
story.community_name: First paid gigs: pay, bands and young beginnings

blocks.x: Now, was the Harlem Opera House engagement in New York City the band's first professional engagement?

No. You know, while we was in school, I just thought about this. We came up special to play a week at Jones Beach in one of the restaurants there. We played a week there. I think that was 1932. We played that week and went back to school.
And so, that would have been your first professional engagement?
That would have been our first.
Right. There's a restaurant, a big restaurant there.
I'll never forget that one. Then we travelled and then we went back to school.
